request.prompt: Which humanoid robots can be purchased in Asia?

result.text:
The commercial market for humanoid robots based in Asia—particularly in China—has rapidly shifted from research prototypes to commercially available units for developers, enterprises, and high-end consumer applications.

Several notable humanoid robots can be purchased or ordered directly through manufacturers or commercial distributors:

Unitree G1 & H1 / H2 Series (Unitree Robotics - China)

Overview: Unitree offers some of the most competitively priced general-purpose and locomotion-focused humanoids globally. The agile Unitree G1 human-sized robot is listed commercially starting around $13,500 USD. Their heavier-duty research models like the H1 and H2 range from roughly $29,900 to $90,000+ USD.
Availability: Available directly via the Unitree Robot Store.

UBTECH Walker Series / Walker S2 (UBTECH - China)

Overview: UBTECH's industrial-grade humanoid line (such as the Walker S2) is heavily deployed in smart factories, logistics, and automotive/aviation manufacturing lines (including partnerships with brands like Airbus). They also offer service-oriented models.
Availability: Marketed toward enterprise buyers and industrial fleets, and accessible commercially via international robotics distributors like Robots International (custom quotes required).

UBTECH UWorld U1 (UBTECH - China)

Overview: An ultra-realistic, social/bionic humanoid featuring soft silicone skin, real hair, and conversational emotional AI capable of recognizing numerous emotional states.
Availability: Sold in tiered packages ranging from a Light tier ($17,600) up to an Ultra custom tier ($145,000).

Droidup Moya (Droidup - China)

Overview: A lightweight bionic humanoid (~32 kg, 1.65 m tall) equipped with heated skin (32-36°C) to mimic body temperature, advanced facial expressions, and a high-accuracy walking gait.
Availability: Targeted at hospitality, corporate reception, and high-end companionship, priced around $173,000 USD with direct enterprise/individual sales inquiries open.

Fourier GR-1 (Fourier Intelligence - China)

Overview: A general-purpose humanoid with strong payload capabilities and 25–27 degrees of freedom, built for rehabilitation, healthcare assistance, and general research.
Availability: Offered primarily to institutional and enterprise buyers as a development platform, generally priced around $125,000 USD.

If you are looking to purchase one, let me know:

Are you looking for a developer/research platform (like Unitree) or an industrial/service robot (like UBTECH)?
What is your approximate budget range?

I can help you narrow down the best fit and point you to the right procurement channel.
